ICS 25.200FAD 02Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the requirements and methods for sampling and test for welded austenitic stainless-steel tubes for the sugar industry covering juice heaters, evaporators and vacuum pans.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
